owner_declaration_reply.options_text: Proposed: band margin [0.30, 0.45] and ECE [0.07, 0.12]; attempt_cap 2; retry_classes [in-band-gate-fail, waived]; a waived acceptance counts as inconclusive

must_note: deploy_eligible is the PACK TASK's verify (pack-outcome.json), which the evaluator reads; a local laya-verify refusal on the arm64 Mac is a recorded cross-CPU finding, not a MUST clause (owner decision at the 14-14 Task 3 checkpoint)

report_only.train_wall_basis: REPORT-ONLY, never a gate. The comparable figure is the trainer's own train_wall_seconds. Basis is scored rows, measured on the A10G in the 14-14 smoke: scoring about 1 s per row per seed, about 1.3 s per row per rescore-noise set (two sets), about 0.033 s per fit-row-epoch, plus a shift probe when present. Predicted for motivation-v1 (100 eval rows, 295 train rows, 12 epochs) about 1000 to 1100 s [ASSUMED: extrapolated from two measured points, 2882.9 s for 459 eval + 280 shift rows and 1509.1 s for 280 eval rows]. 2256 s (3 x 752 s) is kept only as an upper report line; it is not the basis because Phase 12's 752 s was an MPS run and the GPU wall is dominated by scoring, not training

phase12_reference.note: reported beside the SageMaker figure, not used as its basis

noise_reference.note: the SageMaker record is the first x86_64 measurement for motivation-v1

retry.rule: an in-band GATE FAIL (and, when listed, a waived acceptance) may be retried up to attempt_cap; an out-of-band metric, a CPU device, a refused pack or a disagreement with recipe, inputs or seeds is a defect and is never retried

waiver_note: Phase 12's pilot waiver motivation-v1-pilot-ece binds to the same task/train/eval sha256 and recipe id (the recipe id excludes the device), so a waived acceptance is possible; per 14-01 a waived acceptance is completed-but-expiring (laya-retention expire), and under this rule it is inconclusive, not reproduced
run_authorized_scope: plan 14-15's reproduction up to attempt_cap 2; stop if inconclusive (owner repro-go)
